claim_boundary: Synthetic exposure-weighted contagion mechanics are validated on gold sets; real/public exposure contagion claims remain withheld until legally usable exposure graphs are attached and perturbation stability passes.

graph_sufficiency_verdict_contract.global_risk_report_sentence: Contagion Risk: graph sufficiency verdict must be printed before DebtRank/Eisenberg-Noe ranking; single-edge or unstable graph remains N/A / insufficient network.
graph_sufficiency_verdict_contract.product_line: Report graph sufficiency before any precise contagion ranking.

may_claim: Synthetic exposure-weighted clearing/cascade mechanics pass deterministic gold-set checks.
Perturbation battery reports whether top-5 critical-node rankings are stable, degraded, or unstable under missing/perturbed edges and weights.
Graph sufficiency verdict says whether current graph incompleteness permits precise top-5 ranking, requires caution, or blocks precise ranking.
Public exposure-weighted network lanes are contract-ready but remain data-required until source hashes and legal-use notes attach.
must_not_claim: Do not claim real bank, insurer, sovereign, intercompany, or portfolio contagion from synthetic gold sets.
Do not claim DebtRank/Eisenberg-Noe production validation from topology-only public graphs.
Do not publish a precise top-5 ranking when perturbation status is DEGRADED or UNSTABLE.
Do not treat overlapping-portfolio weights as bilateral credit liabilities.

perturbation_contract.level_semantics: Requested levels are perturbation probabilities or max weight-noise amplitudes. CSV reports effective_perturbation_share_mean for small synthetic networks.

stability_thresholds.degraded: Any cell not meeting STABLE and not crossing UNSTABLE thresholds.
